top_choice_rationale: P004 credits a new physical-chemical principle of molecular organisation: multivalent weak interactions drive demixing into compartments described by phase diagrams, valency and interfacial tension. Hyman and Brangwynne (P granules as liquids, 2009) and Rosen (multivalent phase transition, 2012) are the founding, quantitatively reconstituted and widely reproduced experiments, and a citation limited to the principle and those experiments avoids endorsing contested cellular condensates. Base editing (P001) is a close, mature second with a tractable Liu, Komor and Gaudelli allocation; targeted protein degradation (P002) follows because of unresolved clinical maturity and the cereblon glue attribution; nitrogenase structure (P003) is solid but narrower, and an award is preferred to no award.
recusal_note: No shortlisted laureate is a known colleague or collaborator; field overlap with phase behaviour of biomolecules (P004) in lipid and membrane physical chemistry, not treated as grounds for recusal. Lund colleagues Linke and Somfai sit on the committee, which is not a recusal ground.
